title: Hold a driving instructor licence
what: Hold the state's driving instructor licence, authority or accreditation before giving driving lessons for reward.

sources.title: Motor Vehicle Drivers Instructors Act 1963 (WA)
sources.quote: 5. Driving instructors required to have licence or permit (1) After the expiration of 3 months from the coming into operation of this Act, a person shall not — (a) act as a driving instructor in respect of a motor vehicle, unless authorised to do so by a licence or permit held by the person;
